column1: # options|skill|explanation|4 practice stems|mock02 stem|mock03 stem|mock04 stem. Correct option is first.

despite/although/because/unless|介系詞與連接詞|despite 後接名詞片語，although 則接完整子句。|The outdoor market remained open ------- the heavy rain.|The audit was completed ------- a shortage of staff.|The bicycle arrived undamaged ------- the torn packaging.|The team reached an agreement ------- their initial differences.|The exhibition attracted visitors ------- the rail strike.|The printer continued working ------- its age.|The shipment reached the island ------- the rough sea.

until/during/while/since|時間介系詞|until 表示某個狀態一直持續到指定時間。|The loading gate will remain closed ------- noon.|Please keep the samples ------- the end of the trial.|The offer remains valid ------- next Friday.|The replacement machine is unavailable ------- Monday.|The lobby display will stay in place ------- December.|The contractor cannot start ------- tomorrow.|Keep your receipt ------- the warranty expires.

whose/who/whom/which|關係代名詞|whose 表所有關係，後面接名詞。|Applicants ------- portfolios include digital illustrations are encouraged to apply.|The supplier ------- warehouse flooded has arranged another delivery.|Visitors ------- tickets were purchased online can use this entrance.|The designer ------- proposal won will lead the project.|Employees ------- access cards have expired should contact security.|Guests ------- luggage is delayed may borrow essential items.|The researcher ------- findings were published will speak today.

to submit/submitting/submitted/submit|不定詞|agree 後接 to 加原形動詞。|The partners agreed ------- their comments in writing.|The vendor agreed ------- a revised estimate.|All finalists agreed ------- original designs.|The landlord agreed ------- the inspection report.|The committee agreed ------- a joint recommendation.|The applicant agreed ------- proof of previous employment.|The organizer agreed ------- the final seating chart.

reviewing/review/reviewed/to review|動名詞|介系詞 after 後面以動名詞表示動作。|After ------- the safety report, the manager closed the area.|After ------- the menu, the client selected a vegetarian lunch.|After ------- the survey, we extended our opening hours.|After ------- the lease, the tenants requested a correction.|After ------- the footage, security identified the missing box.|After ------- the quotation, purchasing approved the order.|After ------- the instructions, the volunteers assembled the shelves.

has been/have been/is being/being|現在完成式|單數主詞搭配 has been；since 表示從過去持續至今。|The information desk ------- open since early morning.|The west entrance ------- locked since the alarm test.|The regional office ------- responsible for this account since April.|The payment system ------- stable since the update.|The temporary shelter ------- available since the storm.|The workshop ------- fully booked since registration began.|The museum shop ------- closed since the renovation started.

must/ought/has/should have|情態動詞|must 後接原形動詞，表示必要義務。|Visitors ------- display their passes throughout the tour.|All drivers ------- stop at the security booth.|Participants ------- bring identification to collect their certificates.|Customers ------- return the original item to receive a replacement.|Technicians ------- disconnect the power before opening the panel.|Applicants ------- sign both copies of the agreement.|Suppliers ------- include the purchase order number on invoices.

carefully/careful/care/caring|副詞修飾動詞|空格修飾動詞，需要副詞 carefully，意為仔細地。|Please inspect each glass panel ------- before unloading it.|The archivist ------- unfolded the old map.|The agent listened ------- to the caller's explanation.|The accountant checked the balance -------.|The editor ------- compared the two versions.|The pharmacist ------- checked the storage temperature.|The mechanic ------- adjusted the new brakes.

reliable/reliably/reliability/rely|形容詞與名詞|名詞前需要形容詞 reliable，表示可靠的。|The laboratory needs a ------- source of clean water.|A ------- courier is essential for delivering fresh produce.|We are seeking a ------- supplier of replacement filters.|The guide offers ------- information about local transport.|The agency has a ------- network of interpreters.|Choose a ------- method for backing up the archive.|The sensors provide ------- measurements in humid conditions.

approval/approve/approved/approvingly|名詞詞性|所有格或形容詞後接名詞 approval，意為核准。|The alterations require written ------- from the owner.|Final ------- depends on a successful safety inspection.|The research team is waiting for budget -------.|No samples can be distributed without prior -------.|The advertising campaign needs the director's -------.|Construction will begin after formal -------.|Travel ------- must be obtained before booking a flight.

more/most/much/many|比較級|than 引導比較，此處用 more 加形容詞。|The revised form is ------- convenient than the old version.|This fabric is ------- durable than the cheaper alternative.|The evening route is ------- reliable than the morning service.|The new warehouse is ------- accessible than our previous location.|A digital archive is ------- flexible than a paper filing system.|The updated chart is ------- informative than the original.|The folding table is ------- portable than the solid wooden desk.

the most/more/much/many|最高級|在三個以上對象中比較，the most 加形容詞表示最高程度。|Of all the entries, this design is ------- practical.|Among the available options, the train is ------- economical.|Of the five proposals, the final one is ------- detailed.|This is ------- efficient machine in our entire workshop.|Among all the candidates, she is ------- experienced.|This was ------- successful exhibition in the gallery's history.|Of the six materials tested, this one proved ------- durable.

themselves/them/their/they|反身代名詞|動作由主詞自己完成，使用反身代名詞 themselves。|The volunteers assembled the display -------.|The owners painted the shop -------.|The researchers checked the figures -------.|The guests prepared the refreshments -------.|The trainees introduced ------- at the start of the session.|The musicians transported the equipment -------.|The committee members organized the event -------.

each/every/all/both|限定詞|each of 加複數名詞，表示其中每一個；動詞使用單數。|------- of the proposed locations has a loading area.|------- of the new employees receives a security card.|------- of the samples contains a different pigment.|------- of the meeting rooms has a screen.|------- of the selected suppliers offers technical support.|------- of the completed forms requires a signature.|------- of the available apartments includes a balcony.

unless/despite/during/without|條件連接詞|unless 引導完整子句，意為除非。|The event will proceed ------- the weather becomes dangerous.|The pass cannot be replaced ------- you report it missing.|The order will not be shipped ------- payment is confirmed.|The display must remain covered ------- a guide is present.|The fee is nonrefundable ------- the organizer cancels the workshop.|The machine will not restart ------- the cover is closed.|Visitors cannot enter the archive ------- a staff member accompanies them.

because/because of/despite/due to|原因連接詞|because 後面接完整的主詞與動詞子句。|The bakery closed early ------- its water supply was interrupted.|The appointment was moved ------- the specialist was unavailable.|The parcel was returned ------- the address was incomplete.|The trail is closed ------- repairs are still in progress.|The talk was recorded ------- several members could not attend.|We ordered extra chairs ------- registration exceeded expectations.|The shipment requires inspection ------- the seal was broken.

been/being/be/is|被動語態|has already been 加過去分詞構成現在完成式被動語態。|The draft has already ------- reviewed by the legal team.|The floor has already ------- cleaned by the night staff.|The estimate has already ------- approved by the client.|The route has already ------- inspected by the supervisor.|The application has already ------- processed by the office.|The machine has already ------- repaired by the technician.|The package has already ------- delivered to reception.

will be/were/have been/being|未來被動語態|未來時間配合 will be 加過去分詞，表示即將被安排的事。|The winning design ------- announced next week.|The damaged boards ------- replaced tomorrow.|The certificates ------- mailed after next month's ceremony.|The final results ------- published next Monday.|The new seating plan ------- introduced next season.|The outdoor lights ------- installed next spring.|The revised prices ------- displayed starting next Tuesday.

fewer/less/little/much|可數量詞|複數可數名詞搭配 fewer，表示數量較少。|The revised procedure requires ------- signatures than before.|The smaller van carries ------- passengers than the bus.|The online form contains ------- questions than the paper version.|We received ------- complaints this month than last month.|The new route includes ------- stops than the old route.|The digital campaign used ------- printed leaflets than last year's campaign.|The replacement model has ------- moving parts than its predecessor.

less/fewer/many/several|不可數量詞|不可數名詞前用 less，表示較少的量。|The new process produces ------- waste than the old method.|This packaging uses ------- plastic than the previous design.|The express service takes ------- time than standard delivery.|The smaller motor consumes ------- energy than the original.|The revised policy involves ------- paperwork than before.|The insulated room loses ------- heat than the other rooms.|The portable unit requires ------- maintenance than the larger model.

by/at/on/from|期限介系詞|by 指最晚在某個截止時間之前完成。|Please return the signed form ------- the end of the day at the latest.|Payment must reach our office ------- Friday at the latest.|The committee needs the final figures ------- noon at the latest.|All entries must be received ------- September first at the latest.|The supplier must confirm availability ------- tomorrow at the latest.|Please submit travel claims ------- the final working day at the latest.|The keys must be returned ------- ten tomorrow morning at the latest.

in/at/on/to|固定介系詞|in advance 是事先的固定用語。|Reserve a loading space ------- advance to avoid delays.|Special meals must be requested ------- advance.|Please notify the guide ------- advance if you need assistance.|Order replacement parts ------- advance of the busy season.|Participants should read the materials ------- advance.|Visitors must book archive access ------- advance.|Tell the organizer ------- advance about any dietary restrictions.

responsible/responsibility/responsibly/respond|固定搭配|be responsible for 表示負責某事。|The evening supervisor is ------- for locking the rear gate.|Our facilities team is ------- for testing the alarms.|The local branch is ------- for processing returns.|The lead editor is ------- for checking references.|The tour coordinator is ------- for distributing headsets.|The warehouse manager is ------- for tracking damaged stock.|The tenant is ------- for keeping the shared entrance clear.

either/neither/both/every|對等連接詞|either 與 or 搭配，表示兩者擇一。|You may collect the package ------- at reception or at the loading dock.|The interview can take place ------- online or in person.|Payment can be made ------- by card or by bank transfer.|Choose ------- the printed guide or the audio tour.|The report may be submitted ------- electronically or by post.|The workshop will be held ------- in the library or in the school hall.|The item can be replaced with ------- a blue model or a gray model.

neither/either/both/each|對等連接詞|neither 與 nor 搭配，表示兩者皆不。|The revised fee includes ------- meals nor accommodation.|The device requires ------- batteries nor an external power supply.|The room has ------- windows nor a ventilation fan.|The offer applies to ------- existing orders nor clearance items.|The position involves ------- sales calls nor evening shifts.|The route passes ------- the airport nor the central station.|The replacement is available in ------- red nor green.

available/availability/availably/avail|形容詞補語|become 後接形容詞 available，表示變得可取得。|Additional seats will become ------- when the balcony reopens.|Replacement filters will become ------- after the next shipment.|The archived files will become ------- once scanning is complete.|More appointments will become ------- when the new specialist arrives.|The application form will become ------- when registration opens.|Fresh produce will become ------- after the morning delivery.|A larger meeting room will become ------- following the renovation.

so/such/very/too|程度與結果|so 加形容詞，再接 that 結果子句。|The response was ------- positive that we added another session.|The instructions were ------- clear that no demonstration was needed.|The box was ------- heavy that two workers had to move it.|The speaker was ------- popular that tickets sold out immediately.|The hallway was ------- narrow that the cabinet would not fit.|The notice was ------- brief that several details were omitted.|The product was ------- successful that the factory increased output.

who/which/whose/where|關係代名詞|先行詞是人，且關係代名詞在子句中作主詞，使用 who。|The person ------- handles payroll is away today.|Employees ------- work outdoors will receive protective clothing.|Customers ------- register online receive a confirmation email.|The assistant ------- arranged the visit will meet you at reception.|The contractor ------- inspected the roof has sent a report.|Passengers ------- need assistance should speak to the driver.|The volunteer ------- manages the garden is organizing a workshop.

to/for/of/at|固定搭配|access to 加名詞表示能夠使用或進入。|Registered members have access ------- the online archive.|The pass provides access ------- the staff parking area.|Guests receive temporary access ------- the wireless network.|The new ramp improves access ------- the main entrance.|Only the administrator has access ------- confidential records.|The rental includes access ------- a shared kitchen.|The ticket gives visitors access ------- all permanent exhibitions.

whether/because/during/despite|名詞子句|whether 表示是否，後面接完整子句。|Please confirm ------- the replacement parts have arrived.|We need to know ------- the venue provides microphones.|The manager asked ------- the documents had been signed.|Check ------- the attachment opens correctly.|The technician will determine ------- the sensor needs replacement.|Let us know ------- you require a printed certificate.|The organizer asked ------- extra transport would be necessary.
